_comment: Gate-0 freeze for the varga-language milestone. Primitive/predicate/verdict levels for every castable golden. Regenerate ONLY with a deliberate, reviewed doctrine change — this file existing is what makes 'nothing changed' provable.

legend.v: varga name -> digest of every planet's sign in that division
